from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TypedDict, NotRequired
import cattrs
@dataclass
class Child:
    a: int
    b: int = 3
@dataclass
class Parent:
    child: Child
    items: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)
r = cattrs.partial_structure({'child': {'a': '1', 'b': 'bad'}, 'items': ['bad']}, Parent)
assert r.value == Parent(Child(1, 3), []) and r.failed_fields == frozenset({'child', 'items'})
r = r.refine({'child': {'b': '4'}, 'items': ['5']})
assert r.is_complete and r.value == Parent(Child(1, 4), [5])
class TD(TypedDict):
    x: int
    y: NotRequired[int]
r = cattrs.partial_structure({'x': '1'}, TD)
assert r.value == {'x': 1} and r.failed_fields == frozenset({'y'})
print('partial structure checks passed')
